title: Saltline
recoveryNotes: The public version manifest exposes one index.html file only; no unbundled source files or source map were supplied.
Removed only the 40960-byte Claude frame runtime wrapper before verifying the original file against the published manifest.
Development sources are extracted from the verified published HTML. The bundled Three.js r180 runtime stays at its original version.
Game geometry, textures, effects and audio are generated procedurally by the game; only the external Google Fonts stylesheet and font binaries need local copies.
